message:
We all know that feeling of being unprepared when the unexpected happens. That's why taking a moment to think about our survival kits can be such a small win that makes a big difference! With the right supplies at hand, we can face whatever comes our way with a little more confidence. 

The Red Cross has put together some great tips on what to include in our kits, helping us to feel a bit more ready for anything life throws at us. Let’s take a moment to check in on our supplies and give ourselves that peace of mind. Remember, it’s all about those little steps we can take together! 😊
